quest.title: The Secret of Nantianmen
quest.description: Jiayi from Liyue Harbor has gotten himself tangled up in more troublesome affairs, and is looking for some help...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x80000, Hero's Wit x4

talks.objective: Investigate the unusual activity in Nantianmen

dialogues.speaker: Jiu
dialogues.text: The awakening is coming...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Jiu
dialogues.text: Are you here to witness His resurrection?

dialogues.speaker: Jiu
dialogues.text: You're a little early... But you're not too late, either.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...What in the world is she talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Um, what are you talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Jiu
dialogues.text: Huh... Still the truth does not dawn on you...

dialogues.speaker: Jiu
dialogues.text: Though, perhaps it is better that way. For you.

dialogues.speaker: Jiu
dialogues.text: Return now, and await His awakening... Then, you shall surely understand.

talks.objective: Investigate the unusual activity in Nantianmen

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: You're back. What's the situation?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, here's what it's like at Nantianmen...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: ...Earthquakes, monsters, and a little girl... A missing child, presumably?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here's what she said...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: ...She said what? Who's "He"? And what "resurrection"? What a load of nonsense...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Who knows what kind of strange books she must have been reading... Anyway, that's beside the point. I'll send for someone to bring the child back to the city at once.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: First earthquakes, and now monsters... We musn't let that child come to harm.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Thank you so much. Please take these as thanks for running this errand for me.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Ugh, never a slow day of work, eh?

talks.objective: Investigate the unusual activity in Nantianmen

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: *sigh* So much to do...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: You're back. What's the situation?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Everything seems normal...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Normal? So... no earthquakes, no monsters? How strange...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Still, normality is good news. Thank you for your assistance, please take these as a token of my gratitude.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Right, onto the next task... No matter how much I get done, there's always more to do...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like there's nothing strange going on here after all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What's that little girl doing over there...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! Earthquake! What's going on!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Careful, Paimon feels like something bad is about to happen...

dialogues.speaker: Jiu
dialogues.text: When He awakens, you will surely understand.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: You're back. What's the situation?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, here's what it's like at Nantianmen...

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Really? There was actually an earthquake? ...Followed by monsters, out of nowhere?

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: The monsters are no surprise, but these earthquakes... what could be causing them?

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Well, whatever the situation — safety is the top priority.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: I will report the situation in detail to the Ministry of Civil Affairs. Thank you for your assistance, please take these as a token of my gratitude.

dialogues.speaker: Jiayi
dialogues.text: Ugh, the work just keeps piling up, and I can never get on top of it...
